newsitem.title: USA: AMR sets Thanksgiving fare sale.
newsitem.headline: AMR sets Thanksgiving fare sale.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said on Sunday it is cutting fares for the Thanksgiving holiday, offering fares from $88 to $298 roundtrip.
The non-refundable fares require only a one-day advance purchase, American Airlines said.

American Airlines said it is also offering Thanksiving holiday specials to selected international destinations in Europe, Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean with discounts up to 50 percent off regular fares.
American Airlines said the fares require travel to be on November 24, 25 or 28 and the return part of the trip must occur November 28 or 29.
The fares are based upon the mileage of the flight, American Airlines said.
